cohort: 227 postnatal mothers under the care of two urban Primary Health Centers in Puducherry, India
finding: Despite satisfactory antenatal care, the implementation of postnatal care needed improvement, particularly in counselling, home visits, and JSY benefit awareness.
mod_finding: Among mothers who had normal deliveries, 48.1% initiated breastfeeding within 1 hour, compared to 72.4% of mothers who had a cesarean section within 4 hours of delivery.
birth_weight: Reported as low birth weight (<2.5 kg) and very low birth weight (<1.5 kg)
